entries.zh: 聚众共事；集合多人以便行事
entries.en: to gather many people together in order to do something together
entries.notes: 西语尾词 aiton/ayunton 存疑，汉字栏仅记“同”一字，闽南音 chêy-siāu-sōy-tō 四音节未能全部锚定

entries.zh: 搭；会合共做一事（搭伙）
entries.en: to join up together to do something; to team up

entries.zh: 粘合、粘贴〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to join and paste, glue together [damaged entry; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字“棕”疑为“粘”，闽南音栏标残（châ-chā-bà 仅前两音节可读），据西语 juntar pegar 定粘合义

entries.zh: 接合、相连〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to join, be joined [headword truncated; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语词头截断于 ado-，汉字与官话栏皆空，闽南音 cháng-lòng-chàng 无法锚定汉字

entries.zh: 接合；接榫拼合、对接使合缝
entries.en: to join by fitting together; to splice, joint

entries.zh: 纂集；从多方采辑、汇编成书
entries.en: to compile and collect material from many parts; to excerpt and assemble
entries.notes: 汉字“纂/篡”存疑，据西语 tomado de muchos partes 取“纂”（汇编采集）义

entries.zh: 合手；双手合拢
entries.en: to join the hands; to clasp hands together
entries.notes: 汉字第二字“上/手”存疑，据西语 juntar las manos 取“手”

entries.zh: 虾干；晒干的虾
entries.en: dried shrimp(s)
entries.notes: 西语释义句 en la sandez 不可解，据汉字“蝦乾”与闽南音 hê-kuann 定为虾干

entries.zh: 会齐；集合、约齐一处
entries.en: to gather together, assemble as a group

entries.zh: 会众；聚众，众人会合（教会语境指会众聚齐）
entries.en: to assemble the multitude; congregation gathered

entries.zh: 血抱心；血聚心口（血症，血环绕凝聚于心脏）
entries.en: blood gathering around the heart (a traditional medical condition)

entries.zh: 按：juntar、ajuntar 诸译名欠妥〔汉字与闽南音栏空缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: compiler's note: poor equivalents found for juntar/ajuntar; only gan 干 survives in the Mandarin column
entries.notes: 本条为编纂者评注而非词条，四栏仅西语按语与官话栏“干”字存留

entries.zh: 更坏地聚合（聚而益恶）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to join badly, associate for the worse [columns damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语句法残乱且内嵌对音 añgy nngy 不可解，汉字栏空，闽南音 nā-giāy 重复两遍无法锚定

entries.zh: 共同、一道；亦涉平均、对等之义
entries.en: jointly, together; possibly also 'level/equal'
entries.notes: 汉字“正/平”存疑，闽南音 pêng 音近“平”，西语 juntamente 为共同义

entries.zh: 俱；一齐、全都一起
entries.en: all together, jointly

entries.zh: 兼；兼具、同时兼有（兼合二义或二质）
entries.en: both at once, concurrently; to combine two things together (as a complexion combines qualities)

entries.zh: 同我来；跟我一道来（邀约语）
entries.en: come with me; come along together with me

entries.zh: 俱来；一同前来
entries.en: come all together

entries.zh: 大家；全体一起、众人一齐
entries.en: everybody, all together
entries.notes: 西语词头截断处为 juntamente 词尾可复原，todos juntos 完整，与“大家”tâi-ke 互证清晰

entries.zh: 做伙；合伙、结伴成群（聚众成伙）
entries.en: to band together, form a company; to hold an assembly
entries.notes: 词头 Junta[残]mente 缺损为 juntamente 词中，据前后文可复原；汉字“做夥”与闽南音 tsò-hué 互证清晰

entries.zh: 聚会结社；聚众成群
entries.en: to hold an assembly; to form an association or company
entries.notes: 汉字“做飽/做跑”存疑且与聚众义不合，据西语 hacer junta 与闽南音 chô-pū 定聚众义

entries.zh: 咒誓；发誓、赌咒起誓
entries.en: to swear an oath, take a curse-oath
entries.notes: 汉字“咒誓”与闽南音 chiù-chōa 明晰，惟西语内嵌对音 tou chin huan 与官话栏 Roberz 均不可解

entries.zh: 起誓〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to swear an oath [damaged entry; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字与官话栏皆空，闽南音仅单音节 gīn 无法锚定，仅据西语 jurar 存疑定为发誓义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: original damaged; only the Min syllables huān-guān-hau-bon survive, gloss undeterminable
entries.notes: 西语、汉字、官话三栏皆空，仅存闽南音 huān-guān-hau-bon 四音节，无从锚定词条
